hard: auth-by-phone expires_in is EPOCH SECONDS (e.g. 1787843661) — convert to ISO for token_expires_at (hasValidUserAuthToken uses Date.parse)

eval:behavior-live must run against the REDEPLOYED dev Lambda; missing judge key/skipped case/evaluator error = failed gate
soft: Keep contact_phone digits-only for existing consumers; add split fields alongside
Outbound logging failures must never alter the reply
compatibility: Legacy stored plans must still parse — all new schema fields nullable with defaults
security_requirements: X-Agent-Key header on every Agent API call; Bearer user JWT on user-scoped endpoints
Token redaction in traces and eval artifacts
Secrets via Secrets Manager ARNs (SeApiSecretArn); never in code
